title: ‘Soon, my forever’: Carlos Yulo reveals engagement with Chloe San Jose
summary: 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games and 2024 Paris Olympic Games double-gold medalist Carlos Yulo has revealed that he and Chloe San Jose have been engaged for nine months.
